resources.string: No root. No bloat. No data.

A configuration tool for Xiaomi, Redmi and Poco devices. Applies optimizing MIUI / HyperOS parameters via local ADB. All changes are reversible. Results depend on the device model and firmware version.
Safe optimization for Xiaomi, Redmi, Poco. Configures system services and performance parameters.
The app will apply optimizing MIUI / HyperOS parameters and configure system services. All changes are reversible — you can undo them at any time.
Uses AdGuard DNS to filter unwanted domains at the DNS level. May slightly affect internet speed.
Changes additional system parameters. May affect OTA updates and Mi services. Recommended for advanced users only.

Changing DNS may affect internet speed. In rare cases, some websites or apps may load slower or fail to open.

If you notice internet issues after optimization, just undo the optimization — DNS will return to its original settings.

Continue with DNS filter?

To set up the app automatically, enable the "XiaoHyperCleaner" service in the Accessibility menu. It is usually located in the "Downloaded apps / Installed services" submenu.\n\nAfter tapping "Enable", a list of services will open — find "XiaoHyperCleaner", turn on the switch and confirm the system warning.
This permission is needed to show progress. The switch will be enabled automatically — just confirm the action.

Android is blocking the service because the app was not installed from a store.

To continue:

1. Tap the button below ("Open app settings")
2. In the opened window, scroll all the way down and find "Restricted settings"
3. Allow access by toggling the switch
4. If there is no such item at the bottom, tap ⋮ (three dots) in the top right corner — it will be there
5. Return to the app

Android is blocking the service because the app was not installed from a store.

To continue:

1. Tap the button below ("Open app settings")
2. In the opened window, scroll all the way down and find "Forbidden settings"
3. Allow access by toggling the switch
4. If there is no such item at the bottom, tap ⋮ (three dots) in the top right corner — it will be there
5. Return to the app
All parameters and services will be returned to their original state and the device will behave as before. Restore?
Failed to revert changes. Make sure wireless debugging is enabled and try again.
The device will be rebooted via ADB. Unsaved data may be lost. Continue?
Failed to send the reboot command via ADB.
All parameters have been applied successfully. If everything works well, please leave a review — it helps other users find the app.
Failed to apply all changes. Please send the log to the developer to identify the issues.
XiaoHyperCleaner applies optimizing parameters and configures system services on Xiaomi, Redmi and Poco devices. The app works without root via local ADB.
The app needs the accessibility service (for automatic setup) and display over other apps (to show progress). No data is collected or sent anywhere.
All changes can be undone at any time via the "Undo optimization" button. If something goes wrong, the app will automatically restore the original settings.
Enable developer mode — see instructions in the app

Wireless debugging lives in "Developer options", which is currently off.

Enable it once:

1. Tap "Open About phone"
2. Tap "Build number" 7 times until you see "You are now a developer"
3. Return to the app and tap "Continue"
In "Accessibility" find the "XiaoHyperCleaner" service ("Downloaded apps / Installed services" submenu), turn on the switch and confirm the warning.
Scroll app settings all the way down and find "Restricted / Forbidden settings" — turn on the switch. If there is no such item, tap ⋮ (three dots) in the top right corner.
Turn on the "Display over other apps" switch for XiaoHyperCleaner.
Turn on "Wireless debugging". If missing — enable "USB debugging" first, then enable wireless. Confirm all warnings.
Tap "Allow" in the system dialog that appears.
For instant optimization without Wi-Fi and permission chains, install the free Shizuku app. It takes 30 seconds and nothing else needs to be configured.
Shizuku is installed but not running. Open it and tap "Start" — after that optimization will work without Wi-Fi.
Open Shizuku and allow XiaoHyperCleaner to use the API. This is done once.
If Google Play does not allow installation, choose another source:
Shizuku allows faster optimization but requires complex setup. If it does not work — you can skip and use regular optimization.
Tap "Build number" 7 times until "You are now a developer" appears.
Find "Wireless debugging" and turn it on.
In Wireless debugging settings tap "Pair device with pairing code" and copy the 6-digit code.
Open Shizuku, tap "Start via Wireless debugging", paste the code and tap OK.
Shizuku is not running yet.\n\nIf it does not work — tap "Skip" and use regular optimization.
Higher level = more changes. Simple optimization removes most ads and works for everyone.
No Wi-Fi or complex setup. Only toggles in phone settings. For everyone.
Requires Shizuku or wireless debugging. More features.
Everything from advanced + region change. For power users only.
The app will automatically turn off switches in phone settings (ads, recommendations, telemetry). You just tap "Continue" at each step. No Wi-Fi or complex setup required.
Requires Shizuku or wireless debugging. The app will apply more settings: system services, performance parameters, DNS filter. All changes are reversible.
Everything from advanced + region change for maximum ad removal. May affect OTA updates and Mi services. For power users only.
Could not turn off automatically. Try manually or skip.
Find the "%1$s" switch on the opened screen and turn it off. Then return and tap "Continue".
We turned off ads in system apps. Xiaomi will now show less ads and collect less data.\n\nIf the app helped — please rate it or support development.
